story.titleZh: F1车队在蒙扎的能量部署模式揭示了什么
story.summaryZh: 2026年F1赛车在蒙扎这条能量最匮乏的赛道上呈现出明显的能量部署差异，这些差异反映了各车队动力单元管理策略的不同。
story.originalTitle: What F1 teams' Monza deployment patterns have revealed
story.summaryEn: The 2026 Formula 1 cars show clear differences in energy deployment at Monza, the most energy-starved track since the in-season rule changes were agreed in April, revealing differences in how teams manage their power units.
detailZh: 自今年四月赛季内规则修改达成一致以来，2026年一级方程式赛车在蒙扎正处于能量最匮乏的状态，目前各赛车在能量部署方面存在许多值得关注的差异。
各车队——尤其是厂商车队及其客户车队——到了排位赛时往往会在能量部署上趋于接近，而周五的差别则更大。
但通过分析数据、长距离测试里程以及车队和车手在意大利大奖赛上到目前为止的表态，我们仍能看到一些有趣的规律。
法拉利本周末受益于升级后的'ADUO 2'动力单元，但鉴于车队淡化了这个升级幅度有多大，没有理由认为梅赛德斯不再是2026年动力单元的标杆。
从节奏对比数据来看，乔治·拉塞尔在二练做出的全场最快圈速（绿色）与夏尔·勒克莱尔的最佳成绩（红色；慢0.120秒）相比，可以看出法拉利在前三条直道上都输给了梅赛德斯，以至于进入阿斯卡里弯时勒克莱尔已经落后了0.466秒。
从阿斯卡里弯出来驶向帕拉波利卡弯（阿尔博雷托弯）时，法拉利追回了大部分损失的时间——这是一个有趣的动力输出分配差异，如果周末保持这一状态，周日的第一圈肯定会非常精彩。而且正如亚历克斯·阿尔本在周四指出的那样，还要加上一点：“法拉利在（开局阶段）往往很善于抓机会；他们会使用不同的模式，能让其他赛车措手不及”。
如果想更深入了解法拉利在意大利大奖赛开局的表现，请查看埃德·斯特罗的分析。
升级后的法拉利引擎到底有多强？
对比哈斯车队的两名车手确实给你提供了一个不同寻常的机会，可以评估升级后的法拉利动力单元，因为奥利·贝尔曼已经用上了，而队友埃斯特班·奥康还没有。
不过这也有一个前提，那就是奥康一直受到部件一致性问题的影响，这个问题困扰了哈斯整个赛季。
这些不一致往往会导致下压力损失或某种异常的驾驶感受，这肯定能在很大程度上解释奥康比贝尔曼慢一秒的原因——贝尔曼在第二次自由练习中排名第八。
但是贝尔曼（紫色线）和奥康（白色线）在直道上的速度差异非常明显，无论是开往阿斯卡里弯还是进入帕拉波利卡弯的路段都能看出来。
说实在的，我们只有先解决那些部件规格不一致的问题，才能真正知道各款动力单元之间的差距。
毫无疑问，哈斯车队（两辆赛车都装上了）的空气动力学升级套件表现相当出色，博尔曼称之为自三月份以来“最好的周五”。
这正是哈斯急需的，因为该车队长久以来一直游离在积分区之外，自六月份摩纳哥大奖赛之后的六轮比赛都未能得分。
从周五的表现来看，迈凯伦对蒙扎赛道会很难打的预期看起来是正确的——兰多·诺里斯在单圈速度上比拉塞尔慢了近十分之四秒，而在长距离节奏上差距还要更大一些。
迈凯伦负责工程的技术总监尼尔·霍尔迪说：“从能量角度来看，我们还有一些工作要做。”
“确实有圈速可以争取，一部分在充电（管理）上，一部分在能量部署（deployment）上。”
GP Tempo 的数据确实支持了这一点，如果你对比拉塞尔（绿色曲线）和诺里斯（木瓜色曲线）。
即使使用相同的动力单元，迈凯伦在一号弯之后的三条长直道上都在损失时间——尤其是驶向帕拉波利卡弯的那一段格外痛苦。
我们今年已经多次看到，梅赛德斯和客户车队迈凯伦在周五采用截然不同的能量释放策略，而迈凯伦会在学习之后从排位赛开始逐渐趋同。
迈凯伦成功运行了它所称的“H翼”（H-wing）的修改版本，除非车队在数据中突然发现什么问题，否则“没有理由把它拆下来”。
诺里斯总结道：“我们会看看今晚能改些什么，但与过去几个周末相比，我们的处境没那么好，所以，是的，很艰难。”
它较短的齿比在这里也帮不上忙。它知道自己今年把齿比调错了，但由于成本原因，它不想动用唯一一次的更改机会（奥迪已经用过），这笔成本本可以用于空气动力学升级。
红牛的情况也差不多，如果它想有机会加入梅赛德斯与法拉利的争夺，就需要一个富有成效的隔夜调整期。对车队来说唯一的安慰是维斯塔潘的长距离跑很扎实，只比梅赛德斯慢了零点三秒，这可能支撑了技术总监皮埃尔·瓦克的希望：如果红牛能在一夜之间取得进步，登上领奖台仍然是有可能的。
对于阿斯顿·马丁-本田来说，这是最糟糕的情况下的赛道，因为它在动力单元上有相当大的差距——而升级后的“第二规格”引擎并没有解决这个问题。
对比费尔南多·阿隆索在第二次自由练习中的最快单圈与中场领跑者阿尔维德·林德布拉德的最快单圈，可以清楚地看到阿隆索在每一条直道上都有巨大的损失。
仅在驶向一号弯的直道上，阿隆索就损失了零点四秒，而从阿斯卡里弯出口到帕拉博利卡弯更是损失了整整半秒。
本田的首席工程师折原慎太郎表示：“从成绩可以看出，与竞争对手相比，我们的直道速度还不够。
'这并不意外，我们知道在这条对动力单元性能如此重要的赛道上，这个问题会暴露出来。'
'因此，这条赛道对我们来说是一个挑战。我们会优化设定，尽可能将我们的性能最大化，但对接下来会发生什么，我们应该保持现实的态度。'
接下来他们很可能要与凯迪拉克以及潜在的威廉姆斯展开争夺，力争在本周末避免在赞德沃特第九名的水准之后重新跌回发车区末尾。
不出所料，围绕蒙扎跑一圈的单圈GPS数据与一年前相比看起来截然不同。
对比诺里斯在2025年二练做出的最快时间（橙色）与拉塞尔在2026年二练创造的标杆时间（绿色），可以说有天壤之别——两者相差2.681秒。
在两个莱斯莫弯之间、以及驶向阿斯卡里弯、帕拉波利卡弯和冲线的一段直道上，差异相当明显。
与赛季中规则修改之前我们在直道末端看到的那种戏剧性的速度骤降不同，现在的表现更像是速度趋于平缓，但正是在这些地方，他们比一年前损失了大量时间。
周四，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里表示，在周末前的模拟中，蒙扎赛道直道末段的速度比匈牙利站要慢——周五的情况证实了这一点，拉塞尔在匈牙利站一号弯结束时比蒙扎任何一条直道末段都要快6公里/小时。
考虑到倍耐力预计周日的比赛将是一次轻松的一停策略，而且周五轮胎的衰退程度很小，不同的能量释放与回收策略将再次成为关键因素。
detailEn: The 2026 Formula 1 cars are at their most energy-starved at Monza since the in-season rule changes were agreed in April, and there are currently plenty of telling differences in energy deployment between the cars.
Teams - particularly manufacturers and their customers - often converge closer on energy deployment come qualifying, with more variance on Friday.
But there's still some interesting patterns we can see from analysing the data, the long run times and what the teams and drivers have said so far at the Italian Grand Prix.

Ferrari has the benefit of its upgraded 'ADUO 2' power unit this weekend but, given the team's played down how big a step it is, there's no reason to believe Mercedes still doesn't have the benchmark 2026 power unit.

Looking at the GP Tempo data of George Russell's FP2-topping time (green) and Charles Leclerc's best (red; 0.120 seconds slower), you can see the Ferrari loses time to the Mercedes on the first three straights, to the point where Leclerc is 0.466s adrift on the entry to Ascari.

It's out of Ascari and towards the Parabolica (Alboreto corner) where Ferrari claws back most of that time - an interesting deployment split that, if maintained, would certainly make lap one on Sunday exciting. And you can add to that, as Alex Albon pointed out on Thursday, that "the Ferraris tend to be quite opportunistic in [the opening laps]; they run different modes, and they can catch other cars out".
Check out Edd Straw's analysis for a more in-depth look at Ferrari's start to the Italian GP.
How strong is the upgraded Ferrari engine?
Comparing the Haas drivers does give you an unusual opportunity to assess the upgraded Ferrari power unit as Ollie Bearman has it and team-mate Esteban Ocon doesn't.
Though that does come with the caveat that Ocon was suffering from the parts inconsistency issues that have hurt Haas all season.
Those inconsistencies often result in a loss of downforce or feeling that will certainly explain a lot of Ocon's one-second deficit to Bearman - who was eighth fastest in FP2.
But the straightline speed difference between Bearman (purple) and Ocon (white) is noticeable on the run to both Ascari and into the Parabolica.
Really, we'd need those parts inconsistencies to be solved to know the true difference in power units.
Certainly Haas's aero upgrade (which is on both cars) is performing well with what Bearman described as "the best Friday" since March.
That's sorely needed as Haas has long drifted outside of points-scoring contention, having not scored at the six rounds since Monaco in June.

McLaren's expectations of a tough Monza look correct based on its Friday performance, where Lando Norris was almost four tenths off Russell on single lap pace, and slightly further away on long-run pace.
McLaren’s technical director for engineering Neil Houldey said: "From an energy perspective, we've still got a bit of work to do.
"There's certainly laptime there available to us, a little bit moving around recharge, moving around deployment."
The GP Tempo data certainly supports that when you compare Russell (green) and Norris (papaya).
Even with the same power unit, McLaren is losing out on the three long straights after Turn 1 - with the run to Parabolica particularly painful.
We have seen plenty of times this year quite different energy deployment strategies between Mercedes and customer McLaren on Friday, before McLaren learns and starts to converge by qualifying.
McLaren did successfully run the modified version of what it's dubbing its "H-wing", with "no reason to take it off" unless the team has suddenly found something wrong in the data overnight.
Norris summarised: "We'll see what we can change overnight, but we're not in as good a position compared to the last few weekends, so, yeah, tough."

Its shorter gear ratios won't be helping it here either. It knows it pitched them wrong this year, but it doesn't want to use its one joker to change them (as Audi has) because of the cost, which could instead go to aerodynamic upgrades.

Red Bull is in a similar position and will have needed a fruitful overnight period if it's to have any chance of joining the Mercedes/Ferrari fight. The only silver lining for the team was Verstappen's solid long run where he was only three tenths off the Mercedes, which probably underpins technical director Pierre Wache's hope that a podium is still possible if Red Bull takes a step forward overnight.
This is the worst-case scenario circuit for Aston Martin-Honda, given its sizeable power unit deficit - one that its upgraded 'Spec 2' engine hasn't solved.
Looking at Fernando Alonso's best FP2 lap versus midfield leader Arvid Lindblad's, there are clear major losses on every straight.
Alonso loses four tenths on the run to Turn 1 alone and a whopping half a second from exiting Ascari to Parabolica.
Honda's chief engineer Shintaro Orihara said: "As we can see from the results, our straightline speed isn't enough compared to our competitors.
"This isn't a surprise, and we knew this was coming at a circuit where the power unit performance is so important.
"Therefore, this track presents a challenge for us. We will optimise our settings to maximise our performance as much as possible, but we should remain realistic for what’s to come."
What's to come is likely a fight with Cadillac and potentially Williams to avoid returning to the back of the grid this weekend after the Zandvoort ninth-place watermark.
As expected, the GPS data of a single lap around Monza looks very different to one year ago.
There's a night-and-day difference when you look at Norris's FP2-topping time from 2025 (orange) versus Russell's 2026 FP2 benchmark (green) - with 2.681s between them.
There's a sizeable difference in-between the Lesmos and on the run to Ascari, Parabolica, and the finish line.
There isn't the dramatic tail-off in speed that we saw prior to the in-season rule changes at the end of the straights, but rather a levelling off where they lose a lot of time versus one year ago.

On Thursday, Oscar Piastri said the speeds at the end of the straights in Monza in the pre-weekend simulations were slower than they were in Hungary - and that's proved to be the case on Friday, with Russell 6km/h quicker by the end of Turn 1 in Hungary than at the end of any of the Monza straights.
Given Pirelli is expecting Sunday's race to be an easy one-stop with tyre degradation minimal on Friday, differing energy deployment/harvesting strategies will once again be a critical factor.

relatedItems.titleZh: 2026年卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛结果
relatedItems.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。
relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 2026 Qatar Grand Prix qualifying results
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。
以下是排位赛三部分的全部结果：
11 Ollie 贝尔曼 (哈斯) 1m23.367s +0.240s (与Q3差距)
17 塞恩斯 (威廉姆斯) 1m24.370s +0.096s (与Q2差距)
19 安东内利·阿隆索 (阿斯顿·马丁) +0.436秒
detailEn: George Russell claimed pole position as Mercedes dominated Qatar Grand Prix qualifying for its first one-two since the Canadian Grand Prix in May.
Here are the full results from all three parts of qualifying:
11 Ollie Bearman (Haas) 1m23.367s +0.240s (gap to Q3)
17 Carlos Sainz (Williams) 1m24.370s +0.096s (gap to Q2)
19 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +0.436s

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
